data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node 0bb6167c36cf abstracts the mechanisms of SRC_001 and SRC_004 into a 'Cognitive Scaffold Theory', where the checklist's value is not in its content but in its ability to force a 'stop-and-think' state; this is refuted if the removal of the checklist but retention of the 'stop-and-think' requirement produces identical reliability gains.
